game.name: Spectral Force 3 (USA)
game.desc: Battles rage in this tactical role-playing game well known in the land of the rising sun. Spectral Force 3: Innocent Rage takes place in the kingdom of Neverland, where you must fight hordes of enemies in turn-based battles where combos can be devastating. There are 150 missions to choose from, and you can fight alongside 40 allies.
